evidence.observation: Reboiler reads ~443 °C, flat and implausible versus all column stages at 63-72 °C; likely sensor fault/miswiring rather than real temperature
Column profile essentially flat (70 °C upper-mid, 63.3 °C top) and unchanging over 20 min, indicating little separation dynamics
Reflux ~0.1 L/h and distillate ~0.2-0.9 L/h, near-zero and noisy, with FYI702 ratio ~6.8 inconsistent with the measured flows

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler temperature reading or thermocouple check, plus a distillate composition (GC) sample to know whether any separation is occurring
